name: Overscaled
description: Whiteboard-collage documentary style: one fixed 1920x1080 white canvas per segment that never moves. Image, diagram, video-loop, and anchor nodes are revealed on it over time and stay persistent, connected by hand-drawn causal arrows — a motion-design board, not a camera moving over a large canvas.

arrows.notes: default_color (red) is used ONLY for kind='callout' edges; alt_color (black) is the default 'sequential' connector color — see SceneEdge.kind / composition._draw_arrow.
arrows.stroke_notes: Overscaled-only overrides read by composition._draw_arrow: thicker stroke, calmer wobble, bigger head. Defaults (6px, 10px wobble, 28px head) still apply to every style without these keys.

camera.notes: The camera never moves — this key is kept only so older SceneGraph JSON with camera_keyframes still deserializes; scene_graph.render ignores it entirely.

metadata.anchor_notes: The subject anchor is drawn as a plain photo at the left of the title row (layout.INLINE_ANCHOR_*), with the title left-aligned next to it, instead of a circled icon in its own band above the stage.
metadata.slot_templates_notes: Overscaled's staggered collage (cx, cy, w, h as stage fractions), passed to scene_graph.layout.compute_layout's slot_templates ONLY for this preset. 2 cards step down from top-left to bottom-right with a gap wide enough for a visible arrow; 3 cards form a triangle (two on top at slightly different heights, one below in the middle), spaced so an arrow from a top card to the bottom card has ~170px to travel. Card 1 of a build lands in slot 1, so 1 -> 2 -> 3 grows like a whiteboard. Solo stays layout.OVERSCALED_SOLO_SLOT. Exp Solar carries no such key and keeps the built-in single-row templates.
